title: Monthly Refresher Training Webinar Recordings
description: Access recorded webinars on managing Healthcare Compliance Pros programs, including OSHA and HIPAA assessments, training reminders, and more. Topics covered: website management, organization-specific training, compliance information resources, and assessments.
body:
Our Monthly Refresher Training Webinars have focused on a variety of topics including: a general overview of managing your Healthcare Compliance Pros program, OSHA and HIPAA Assessments, managing Training Reminders, etc.
